segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu

segments.text_en: The nocturnal divine mandate
evidence: To the house its king spoke
“Build his house!,” he ordered him.
on the lord Ningirsu, Gudea looked.

segments.text_en: Epistemic uncertainty and resolution to seek interpretation
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant, counseled about the message
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me.

segments.text_en: Voyage to Bagara and intercessory prayer to Ningirsu
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
After reaching Bagara—house hanging over the river, he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, the lord Ningirsu, received from him.

segments.text_en: Supplication and filial invocation to Gatumdu
evidence: I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother. I am a no-father-haver, you are my father.
may your good Utukku go in front of me, may your good Lamma follow me on my path.
Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea.

segments.text_en: Arrival at Siraran and narration of the dream to Nanše
evidence: He went to Nanše, he prayed to her
Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth.
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand. She had the tablet of the stars on her lap.

segments.text_en: Nanše's hermeneutic exegesis of the dream symbols
evidence: “My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.
it is surely my brother Ningirsu. ‘Build his shrine, the Eninnu!’ He ordered you.
That is surely Nisaba, my sister.

segments.text_en: Ritual and gift-giving protocol prescribed by Nanše
evidence: Let me give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded.
to the hero who loves gifts, to your king, lord Ningirsu
He will reveal the plan of his house to you.

segments.text_en: Fabrication of sacred offerings and tribute presentation
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood.
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it.
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Sacrificial approach and petition for an unambiguous sign
evidence: Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not.
your ‘heart’, surging, like the ocean, your, receding, like the wave
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’, son of Enlil, lord Ningirsu, I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's grand nocturnal theophany and covenant of abundance
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive.
In the land of stone, large boulders of stone from the mountains, I will cut into blocks for you.

segments.text_en: Awakening and extispicy confirmation
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream. He is afraid, it was a dream.
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
For Gudea, the ‘heart’ of Ningirsu it is the light, that dawned on him.

segments.text_en: Social purification and sacred precinct cleansing
evidence: The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire.
A mother does not accuse a son, accusations, a son to his mother does not speak.
The Anunna of area-Lagash, in order to build the house of Ningirsu... stood with him.

segments.text_en: Universal levy and muster of nations
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands.
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa.
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him.

segments.text_en: Expeditions and resource procurement across mountains and lands
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper, (that) revealed itself to him, the copper he excavated there
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain.

segments.text_en: Nocturnal devotion, architectural alignment, and divine guidance
evidence: he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight, he does not set his head to sleep during midday.
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him. Enki made the plan of the house right for him.
the field was right, he measured it, he placed sticks on its border

segments.text_en: The ritual molding and raising of the first sacred brick
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu.
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged.
He placed the brick, he brought the mold into the house, he lifted the brick from the mold

segments.text_en: Vigilance and final confirmatory omens
evidence: Like a cow whose eye are on its calf, he walked to the house in great concern.
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good. He gave grain to the wave, its appearance was straight.
To build his king’s house, the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention.

segments.text_en: Laying the foundation and the sevenfold blessing
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground, he gave a blessing
For the seventh (time) did he not give a blessing in the house? It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land.

segments.text_en: Erection of the superstructure, sacred chambers, and foundation mast
evidence: They make the house grow like a mountain.
The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain
He made Eninnu firm as a mast.

segments.text_en: Transport, erection, and consecration of the named stelae
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard, ‘the stela, king filling the courtyard...’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in front of the rising sun, ‘the King, roaring storm of Enlil...’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in Baba’s back-room, ‘Eninnu, knowing the face of An, Baba, life of Gudea,’ as name of that stone he named.

segments.text_en: Cosmic visual grandeur and sanctuary architecture
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea made it grow together with heaven and earth.
Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu, made it grow like a mountain of Lapis
He built, and after he had finished it, it is the ‘heart’ of the gods, returned to its banks.

segments.text_en: Installation of conquered monster trophies and mythic standards
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there.
At Šugalam, the gate of radiance, the dragon and the date palm he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place

segments.text_en: Fitting of mythic doors, bolts, and cosmic shielding
evidence: The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven.
The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered.
The house, founded by Anu with purified silver, decorated with good perfume

segments.text_en: Establishment of functional estates, storage, and acoustic cult spaces
evidence: From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries, From the mighty oven, large cakes
In the treasury, precious stones, silver, tin.
The inner room of harps, (called) ‘ox roaring princely’.

segments.text_en: Cosmic stabilization and final doxology to Ningirsu
evidence: The fear of Eninnu covers all the lands like a garment.
Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation.
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised!
